acceptance_checks: A regression test reproduces an unqualified pytest run with foobar/__init__.py raising AssertionError and an ordinary test file; collection does not import foobar/__init__.py and the ordinary test passes.
A package whose non-matching __init__.py would fail on import can still contain nested matching test files, and those tests are collected and run successfully without executing the initializer.
Configuring python_files to include __init__.py continues to collect tests from discovered package initializers.
Explicitly selecting a path such as tests/__init__.py continues to collect it even when the default python_files patterns do not include __init__.py.
Existing package collection, --pyargs/testpaths, and collect_ignore regression tests continue to pass.
The implementation avoids creating a Package collector for a discovered non-matching __init__.py while preserving recursive discovery beneath its directory.
confirmed_decisions: During ordinary recursive directory collection, discovered __init__.py files must satisfy python_files before becoming Python collectors.
When a discovered package initializer does not match python_files, pytest must recurse into the package directory without collecting or importing that initializer.
An explicitly supplied __init__.py path remains eligible for collection even when it does not match python_files, preserving initial-path behavior.
When python_files explicitly includes __init__.py, discovered initializers remain collectable and existing tests defined in them continue to work.
Existing pytest_ignore_collect and collect_ignore behavior must remain effective before collection or import.
summary: Restore ordinary recursive collection so that a discovered package __init__.py is collected and imported only when its path matches the configured python_files patterns. A non-matching initializer must not be imported merely to traverse the package; pytest must still recurse into that directory and collect matching test files below it. Explicitly supplied __init__.py paths remain collectable.
